counting_rules: Charge each distinct original logical run/input path once; local/archive same path+SHA copies are one lineage, but different real run paths still cost separately even if bytes match.
Reuse v2 total15642Harness+49native ledger; original v1tail44 is already included and never re-added.
Any old original logical input path or native command artifact path with changed SHA rejects the audit; immutable wrappers do not overwrite evidence.
Every input case costs an attempt, including zero-frame validation rejection, retries, failed full, calibration/held/counter and fixture calls. Summary success counts never determine cost.
New archive wrappers are SHA verified and merged by original logical identity, not counted as runs. Prior14archive payload verification is reused, not repeated.
Only stable artifacts timestamped at/before fixed cutoff enter this snapshot. Written inputs without completed results still cost their full case count and remain UNKNOWN.

Each new original normalized native Godot write-movie command costs one; copied artifacts and FFmpeg/segments are not new Godot calls. New cosmetic re-recordings still cost native commands but are not independent held calibration.
